worldcombat.skill.bodyslam.summary: Leap up and drop your whole body onto the target point: everyone in the landing zone is hurt and shoved, and the heavier you are the more likely they are left paralysed. The quake form spreads wider but hits softer; the press form is the opposite.
worldcombat.skill.bodyslam.description.1: The landing radius is %1$s blocks; a crushed target has a %2$s%% chance to be left paralysed.
worldcombat.skill.bodyslam.description.2: You can leap from up to %1$s blocks away, rise %2$s blocks, and shove the target %3$s blocks on landing.
worldcombat.skill.bodyslam.use.0: Drop your weight onto one target
worldcombat.skill.bodyslam.use.1: Squash a cluster caught under the landing
worldcombat.skill.bodyslam.use.2: Lean on your weight for a higher paralysis chance
worldcombat.skill.bodyslam.preference.sp: On: a wider landing that shoves harder, but weaker single-target damage, lower numb chance, and a longer recovery and cooldown. Off: the press form, smaller landing with more damage and a higher numb chance.
worldcombat.skill.bodyslam.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of leaping. Larger values dive from further out and get dodged during the rise more often.
On: prefer the press when two or more foes cluster around the target (one landing covers them). Off: only the threat itself counts.
